title: ALLEGIANT TRAVEL COMPANY ANNOUNCES LAUNCH OF TENDER OFFER AND CONSENT SOLICITATION FOR ITS 7.250% SENIOR SECURED NOTES DUE 2027
summary: (NASDAQ: ALGT) (the "Company," "we," "us," or "our") announced today that it is commencing a tender offer (the "Tender Offer") to purchase for cash any and all of its outstanding $403,009,000 remaining aggregate principal amount of 7.250% Senior Secured Notes Due 2027 (the "Notes"). In connection with the Tender Offer, the Company is also seeking consents (the "Consent Solicitation") to proposed amendments (the "Proposed Amendments") to the Indenture, dated as of August 17, 2022 (the "Indenture"), which governs the Notes, that would eliminate most of the restrictive covenants and certain events of default applicable to the Notes, and amend certain other provisions applicable to the Notes.
